Why does my kettle trip the breaker?

Every second boil the kitchen breaker trips. The kettle is 3 kW and the ring is shared with the toaster.

reply · A 3 kW kettle and a toaster on one 13 A ring is right at the limit; move one to another socket.

reply · Check the element for scale — a scaled element draws more for longer.
